status: full 28-layer calibrated sweep executed (positive and negative arms)
strength_convention: alpha = z * sigma_within, sigma_within = pooled within-group sd of the activation projected onto that layer's steering direction
cells: 44/44 eligible at every layer, zero refusals, zero errors

direction_quality._note: Cohen's d of the construction contrast along the steering axis, per layer
direction_quality.reading: Three regimes: d~0.3-0.6 for layers 1-9, d~0.9-1.9 for layers 10-15, and a jump to d~4.5-7.5 at layer 16 which then plateaus. The transition between 15 and 16 is abrupt, not a smooth gradient.

H1_layer_dependence.test: Friedman across all 28 layers at matched z, paired by prompt (n=74)
H1_layer_dependence.reading: Layer is a first-order determinant of steering leverage. The effect is significant at every non-zero dose and grows with dose.

H2_signed_effects.reading: Positive and negative steering are not mirror images. At layers 1-14 the negative arm moves the margin far more (ratios 0.02-0.6); at layers 16-17 and 24-27 the positive arm dominates (ratios 2.3-10.5); around 18-21 they are comparable. The sign of the asymmetry is itself layer-dependent.

H3_heldout_generalization.reason: evaluation split deliberately untouched to keep the selection unbiased

strongest_single_layer.note: largest absolute effect anywhere in the sweep, on the negative arm

answer_flips.reading: Steering reliably moves the logit margin but almost never flips the two-way argmax. Original-answer accuracy does degrade at high dose in mid-late layers (L20 z=12 dropped to 0.405 in the 4-layer pilot), i.e. the intervention disrupts the computation without redirecting it toward the counterfactual.

limitations: 74 calibration prompts; granularity is one prompt per 0.014
single model, single task, single component (block_output), single token position
the direction is a mean difference between two answer positions, not a validated causal direction
effect sizes are on the logit margin, not on task accuracy, because accuracy barely moves
no held-out evaluation, so no generalization claim
layer 0 is degenerate for this purpose: sigma_within is 0.053, so its alpha grid is tiny and the direction is near-noise (d=0.95 comes from a near-zero denominator)
next_steps: run the chosen configuration once on the evaluation split
test on a second model to check the layer-16 transition is not task-specific
increase calibration prompt count, 74 is small for effect sizes of 0.05-0.2
